paragraphs.text: The Scion of the Ur-Dragon is a legendary dragon avatar on Dominaria .

The Scion of the Ur-Dragon is a dragon on Dominaria active during the Temporal crisis of Dominaria . The Scion - like all dragons - was granted physical might, powerful magic, and peerless intelligence through the spirit of the Ur-Dragon . It, however, feels this visceral bond to the Ur-Dragon more closely than most and in turn believes itself to be the blood of its powerful ancestor.
